description: CHISONE-GERMANASCA Alluvione 13-16/10/2000 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by archivio.cittametropolitana.torino.it. The data are taken from the hydrogeological study promoted by the former Province of Turin as part of the "Research programme on the maintenance and restoration of riverbeds of watercourses, as well as on hydrogeological protection and soil protection".The dataset represents some critical elements associated with the full verification along the auction of the Chisone ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "CHISONE-GERMANASCA Flood 13-16/10/2000" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT, alluvione 2000, direzioni di deflusso, frane, erosioni, erosioni di sponda. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
